reviews.text: Very pleased with Otis’ first visit. A lovely, even shape to his face and exactly the right amount of trim. He looks great! We’re loving the St Patrick’s Day bandanna as well 🇮🇪
Fabulous 🐾 Thank you Coco Belle Dog Grooming

Daisy looked splendid after their grooming session. Totally recommend  Coco Bello! Lovely staff. Happy dog. 😊
Ursula …
Thrilled with the grooming our cockapoo Bailey got today and so impressed by the warm and welcoming staff, thank you so much, Bailey is a happy cooled down dog tonight. Vanessa
Had my Westie Obi groomed today. Despite  my westie  being nervous and totally uncooperative Jayden and the team did a fantastic job grooming him.

Tobi looking fab after his groom
Thank you for great service

On behalf of my grandmother Vanessa Caminiti: “Dusky and Zen thank Coco Bello for making us look and feel young and beautiful. We are senior, long-haired big dogs, being groomed for the first time but you were very kind and patient, well done”!
Our dog is always excited to go in to Coco Bello to be groomed. He is very well cared for  while there and comes out very pleased with himself and his fresh look! Thanks guys.
My v anxious and old dog Lola now groomed here. I find the service v good and having the same staff helps Lola. Thanks
Lola came back a very happy dog beautifully groomed. Excellent service. Staff superb.
The standard of the service is amazing and the staff are always so pleasant.

This was my puppy’s second visit to Coco Bello, and I’m really happy with the service. Everyone is so friendly and welcoming, and they took great care of her. She came back looking adorable, smelling amazing, and seemed really happy. Definitely recommend Coco Bello to anyone looking for a professional dog groomer.

Excellent work.  Poppy is looking great.
Thank you.
I have had my dog cooper with the guys in coco belle today. He is very nervous and the guys were so good with him and did a great job. He looks a lovely boy now.
Cookie loves going to Cocobello, Sophie her groomer, is so kind to her and she comes out looking beautiful !
Ruby and Sandy  look amazing brilliant service from start to finish thanks you

They are amazing…
100 !  Could not have asked for more …. !
Izzys 3rd groom with Coco Bello. Couldn't be happier she looks amazing and was so happy.
As always, Leo loves Coco Bello and always gets a wonderful grooming! The team is so lovely and the experience is smooth from start to finish!
A very Happy Lola after a much needed Coco Bello Grooming 5*'s from her and we'll see you soon!

I just want to thank the amazing staff in coco bello dog groomers, I had my King Charles cavalier Indie groomed this morning for the first time and what an amazing experience for her and myself. The staff were so professional and kind, they groomed her exactly how I asked. On arriving to collect indie she was so pretty , shiny and smelled so good, she was so stunning with all her bows!! I would highly recommend Coco bello and Indie will be back very soon!!!
Amazing groom for Heidi...such a good wash in particular. Lasts longer than usual. We will be back again! 😊 …
excellent groom no hesitation in recommending these groomers
So happy to see my nervous dog looking fresh, beautiful and happy. I wouldn’t recommend anyone else! Thank you so much!💗 …
Great job done on my little cavalier King Charles. She looks and smells divine. Lovely clean bright premises too
Ralph's first visit to Coco Bello was very relaxed. The staff were lovely and looked after him well. We were delighted with his grooming and have already booked our next appointment
Always pleased with this place. They treat our four little ones very well

Fudge had a lovely morning with the caring groomers in Coco Bello.
Thank you Coco Bello
Fantastic grooming service thank you Bella looks amazing 🐶 …
Wonderful Service. I take my dog there to be groomed and have just the highest of praise for the staff and the premises. Where the dogs are kept and groomed is in full view and spotless.
Great staff and service

I have been taking my dog to Coco Bella since it opened and my dog has never been so relaxed going in the doors of a groomer, and she is always greeted by professionals who clearly love animals. I know the care and attention she gets is first class. She not only gets a great grooming every time, but I see how the staff prioritise the comfort of the dogs, and really care for them. Keep up the good work! Gail & Roxy

Coco had a fabulous pampering lovely grooming this morning .She looked stunning when I collected her . Lovely caring staff whom loved dogs which makes a great difference and definitely would recommend any dog lover to get their dog pampered here. Coco will definitely be back thank you 🫶🫶 …

We had our first visit to Coco Bello today and it was a fantastic experience! They took such great care of our fur babies and  handled them with so much patience and care. It’s a huge relief to finally find a place where grooming isn’t a source of worry —we’ll definitely be back!
Thank you Coco Belle for another fantastic groom for Sadie . I can’t recommend this place highly enough.
Brilliant Groomers. So happy with the results 🐕thanks again x …
Thank you for grooming Oliver. He looks and feels great. Very friendly and helpful staff🥰 …
Have been using Coco Bello for the last 12 months  and delighted with everything, thanks again!!
Milo the mini Schnauzer had a fab time on Friday with Sophie! Thank you so much - he looks fab ❤️
Loved the care that was given to Twofee. Thank you ☺️
The girls are Coco Bello were great and our little cavapoo came home looking stunning ✨
Very professional, excellent communication. Bella came out looking fantastic.
Great service. Very friendly. I'd highly recommend Coco Bello
Brilliant dog groomers! Always so kind and take such care of our very nervous Shih Tzu, would highly recommend.
Hennessy always loves his appointments at Coco Bella! He is treated with such kindness while being beautifully groomed. We highly recommend.🐾 …

Coco bello once again have done an amazing job in my two dogs Sal and Marley. Hair done perfect, washed and smelling lovely, and new doggie bandana. Two visibly happy dogs.
Staff are brilliant, so committed and friendly. Affordable, accommodating and reliable. 5 stars and more if I could give them.

The team is always amazing & super caring with our Pesto - he actually behaves quite well with them! I really appreciate how informative they are about what they do & how they genuinely want the best for your dog. Cannot recommend them enough!!

Love this dog groomers and more importantly so does our dog. The team are so nice and friendly and our big golden retriever always comes out looking beautifully groomed. They will try and accommodate appointments too, would highly recommend.
This was the first time I brought Milo to Coco Bello he is a very nervous dog .. They did an excellent job of grooming him I would highly recommend..

A fantastic grooming service. Staff very pleasant and clearly live dogs.
Thank you all.

Just back from another great experience at Coco Bello, Luna loves her time with the girls they always take the best care with her. As always she looks and smells amazing. All ready for Valentine’s Day 🩷🩷 …
Bonnie had a lovely groom and she was happy there as it was first time and smells amazing. Thank you Coco Bello

Our 5 month old Labrador Florence absolutely loved her gorgeous bath in Coco Bello today. The staff are so polite and cheerful and professional and they love the dogs so much. Florence came home with a colourful neckerchief and all delighted with herself. At soon as she got back to her bed she fell into a lovely sleep. Thanks so much for all your kindness. We will see you again soon. Love Frances, Ted & Florence X xx
Very happy with my dogs groom. Friendly and talented staff! Our dog will definitely be back for a pamper.
I got my dog groomed in Coco Bello today and had a great experience. They were kind and caring with my nervous dog and did an amazing job. Would definitely recommend.

Lovely friendly place . It was our dog Alfie’s first time here & he had a fabulous experience . The staff are very friendly and welcoming and did an excellent job at tidying up an uneven cut from a previous groomers .
Delighted to recommend Coco Bello Dog Grooming without hesitation.
Amazing!!! Liese looks absolutely beautiful and smells fantastic. Coming back 🙏🏻 …
Lovely Xmas glow up and this bandana really suits me.  Must cope with extra cuddles for a while!. 🐕 thank you, Rupert …

My dog loves going into Coco Bello. He loves all the staff and is always so happy to go in the door and be left there for his groom. Everyone there is so lovely and I don't think we'll ever go anywhere else.

Our dog has had his second groom at Coco Bello and has come home smelling divine with a lovely haircut. My preferences for where to leave a bit more hair were listened to and the girls we so nice at drop off and collection time. Thank you so much
Another great grooming for our princess 😁 - Coco Bella team rocks …
Delighted with my groom for Cleo as always . She looks and smells fabulous .
Very, very happy with Bella’s grooming today. The calm atmosphere helped her enjoy the experience, I would definitely recommend Coco Bello

This is the best grooming company! Brodie, always comes out looking stunning and smelling fantastic. The staff is gentle, professional, and clearly loves dogs. They listened to exactly what I wanted for his trim and even got his nails done perfectly (which is usually a battle!). Five stars are well-deserved!

Took my dog here for the first time and I’m super happy with the result! He looked so cute after the grooming, smelled amazing, and was in such a good mood. The haircut was perfect too! Definitely coming back next time 🐾✨ …
New customer, my cockapoo looked amazing after her full groom. I was absolutely thrilled with the job the girls did. Would 100% recommend
I had 100 confidence in leaving my girls with them, really friendly groomers, so kind to my dogs. Highly recommend.
Coco Bello did a beautiful grooming  - many thanks ! She looks lovely !
My Golden Retriever puppy had his first puppy groom today ! He loved it ! I couldn’t recommend Coco Belle Dog Grooming enough 🐶 …

Freddie our cockapoo loved his groom today. It is the first time I have found a groomer which listened to what we wanted for Freddie. It is also the first time that Freddie did not come out of the experience ‘stressed’.
We booked Freddie back immediately for four weeks time.

The salon is spotless, staff very friendly. Has a lovely atmosphere.
Well done!
Spyke loves Coco Bello Grooming! The team is really nice and very professional. Really recommend it!
Sophie was fantastic. Toby had a fantastic time . I would highly recommend Coco Bello .

Lovely experience from start to finish.  Beautiful salon. Sophie did a fantastic job on Teddy 🧸 👏. Price reasonable for the time and effort put into the grooming 12 out of 10 👍. Will definitely be returning.  Would highly recommend 👌. …
Excellent service. Really nice place and friendly staff. Highly recommended.
I would highly recommend getting your furry friends groomed here,  the girls were absolutely terrific with my two and did a super job. They are booked in again as they loved the place.
Lovely girls and super grooming. My Aussie shepards are now beautiful and happy.i would recommend them.

Not a great experience unfortunately. They left many visible matts on him. He now has some cuts on his legs, and when we touch his paws/legs he'll growl aggressively which he never did before. Spent nearly 90euro for this.. did get a cute bandana though and the staff were nice.
Poppy had the nicest pampering with you. She looks and smells amazing. Thank you all so much
Great service ,thank you Nathalie.

Buddy had a lovely visit at Coco Bello this morning looks and smells lovely
Very nice friendly staff 👌 …

Really unhappy with the attitude and service of the manager of the place. My dogs were groomed professionally by the groomers but a terrible experience with an unprofessional manager otherwise. Definitely not going back!
My dog had a wonderful 90 minutes of pampering today at Coco Bello grooming. It's a longtime since he has looked so well. Staff are really lovely, KC will look forward to his next visit. Thank you
Venus had a great time … I can tell 😊 by looking at her and I loved it too. She’s looking great and smelling amazing!!! Def will come back again. …
I thoroughly recommend this groomer. Very caring and understanding.
Excellent service. Roxy looked great after her grooming session

We had such a great experience at Coco Bello! The place is absolutely spotless, and the groomers are not only professional but genuinely kind, you can really tell they love what they do.

Our pup Cookie is very shy and usually nervous with new people, but she was handled so gently and with such care. It made all the difference. Her haircut turned out fabulous, she looks adorable and seems so much more comfortable.

We’ve already booked her next appointment and have been recommending Coco Bello to all our dog-loving friends.

Yesterday was my first time at cocos, and I’m so pleased with the cleanliness, how professional the staff are, they are so friendly and welcoming. My cavachon (daisy) went to coco’s needing a good groom and she came out like a little teddy, the shampoo they use smelted amazing, her groom was perfect! I loved that the staff had little treats for the dogs and when I came back to collect daisy she had the cutest bandanna on and was playing away waiting on me. I will definitely be returning. A big thank you to the staff at cocos for such a great experience for daisy as she was a very nervous dog 🐶.

It was our first time using Coco Bello today. We were very nervous and I needn’t have been . Our Lily (Maltese) came out not only looking happy and relaxed but looking beautiful. The girls did a wonderful job exactly as we wanted her done and the facilities are spotless . We will definitely be back thank you ladies.

I was gonna hold off with the review, but looking at my dog every day makes me say this..😂🥲 I have made an appointment for my Yorkie for a cut, specifically asking to leave long hair at her head (as I always do plats and ponytails) for her, however my request was not heard. I was actually really pleased with the groomer asking for a photo reference and taking notes while on the phone making the appointment, only to have my dog looking like…this.🫢 Not only she did not look like the photo I have provided to the groomer, but she also has some strange layers done to her body hair, + the paws are bald. I had other groomers do her hair before without any references and I have never seen her like this before. I am disappointed and really hope her hair will grow back soon.
Very professional and friendly service from start to finish. My King Charles Cavalier looks absolutely gorgeous, the ladies did a fantastic job! Will definitely be back! 😊 …
Coco Bello provide exceptional service and great value for money. Highly recommended.

I've just collected my Shih tzu from his first grooming at Coco Bello. He looks gorgeous and is so relaxed happy. We Will definitely be back for his next groom. So glad to find a local groomers that not only groom him perfectly but also have such nice people doing it. Thank you Coco Bello

Bella absolutely loved her day out at coco bello’s, the groomers wouldn’t be her favourite place but she almost refused to leave the place, most wonderful staff, so welcoming and top tier care. We have booked already for our next appointment and can’t wait! She was so beautiful when she came out and still has her shine and smell almost two weeks later ☺️ thanks girls, great job.

From the minute the door opened, they were so friendly and the place was fab. They sent me pictures of Teddy been groomed which I thought was a lovely touch, so delighted with the job they did, will definitely be back, luv Maria and Teddy
Another fantastic job. We very lucky to have you in our neighbourhood.

The staff is extremely professional and the
calm atmosphere is nice and relaxing for my little one.
Excellent care for my dogs. Highly recommend coco belle

Fabulous groomers. Lovely bright and clean facilities and lovely friendly staff. My dog was made a big fuss of when he arrived which he loved and put him at ease.  The groom itself was perfect, exactly what I asked for and I’ve already booked my return appointment.
Would recommend without hesitation.

This was my dog’s first visit, with her being a bit of a nervous dog I was a little apprehensive. However, she came out with a groom exactly how I had explained it, looking very smart with a beautifully cut beard. She even posed for the girls perfectly.
First time using CocoBelle so we were a little apprehensive……. No need…. ! We got exactly what we asked for and will definitely be back. Thanks to the girls who took such good care of her. 💕 …

Chico had his first haircut here this week.
This was long overdue !
Staff were both very warm , friendly and professional.
They took time to discuss what kind of cut we wanted . We were thrilled when he bounded out , looking and smelling wonderful and sporting a stylish new bandana.
We will be booking him in  here for his next styling session and highly recommend this great place.
Very clean premises. Grooming was very good. Dog was happy.
Thank you so much.  Appreciate all the time & patience you had to spend  with grooming Percy. He looks great.  👍 …
I am so happy with Coco Bello . Very calm environment for my very nervous dog !  Amazing groomer!

Needed to find a groomer last minute, and one that had the experience to handle my dog Honey's coat. Coco Bello came highly recommended and understood my needs straight away, as well as they were able to fit me in last minute. The end result was incredible, and I could not have been happier.

The staff was attentive, understanding of my needs, and was so extremely pleasant to deal with. I'll be taking her there from now on, and nowhere else!

On holidays from Canada and needed a salon to take special care of my pup. The experience at Coco Bello, start to finish was exceptional. My pup loved the staff, and came out looking phenomenal. 10/10 would recommend.
Fab 👌  Cockapoo. All pampered with a great welcome, kindness and a great result! Thank you …
Our second visit with Daisy to Cocobello, great service, very friendly staff and easy for drop off and collection with the carpark. Would highly recommend.
Totally recommend coco Bella - relaxing experience for the puppy and lovely staff
Did a lovely job with an elderly German Shepherd - highly recommended
Our golden retriever had a fabulous groom in Coco Bello today. Staff and facilities were fantastic. Would throughly recommend.

The team were so professional and so personable on the two occasions we have been in so far. We are delighted with their attention to detail and stellar service! They have gained a customer for life here.
What a fabulous groom & facilities with such attention to detail. Very happy pooch. Thank you very much.
Absolutely lovely service, Roxy looked great after, the girls are lovely 👍 …
Extra friendly staff, excellent results

My two yorkies mila and Bobby got groomed by grace today and grace done an amazing job both dogs look absolutely fabulous, beautiful cut and they smell gorgeous, they will definitely be back in a few weeks xx
Thank you Grace & Natalie for making a nervous doggy very happy & comfortable. What a gorgeous job you did too on our Rosie… beautifully groomed 🩷. We will be back soon. 🐶 …
Wonderful experience from start to finish, Grace was amazing, she took such good care of Teddy. See you again soon.
Great experience with excellent results - highly recommended.
My first visit with my dog KC, delighted with his grooming. He can be nervous but Nathalie was very kind to him. I will be back.

Holly very refreshed after her wash and blow dry
Delighted to see a new business open
Holly can't wait to go back for her next groom
Thank you Coco  Bello team
Five stars for a five star groom! Jessie had a great experience today and looks lovely.

I’ve been bringing my dog to Grace for the past year and a half , we couldn’t recommend Grace enough so professional, loving dog groomer , attention to detail is amazing , the new salon is absolutely beautiful, my dog Daisy absolutely adores Grace , she always does an amazing job , your dog will be well looked after with Grace
Brilliant experience with our 3 year old cockapoo. She looks amazing and came home with a little bow in her hair 🤗 …
I would highly recommend going to Coco Bello Dog Grooming. Nathalie and Grace are so lovely and made my puppy so at ease. I will definitely be going soon.
